info.title: B2B Order Management API
info.description: Multi-tenant B2B order management: customers, product catalog, quotes, orders and role-based access control. Money values are integer cents; rates and discounts are basis points (100 bps = 1%).

status.description: `invited` until the user accepts their emailed invitation

timezone.description: IANA time zone; quote validity dates end at midnight in this zone

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: At least one recognized update field is required.

currency.description: Defaults to the organization's base currency

productId.description: Catalog product; description and price default from it

timezone.description: IANA time zone; quote validity dates end at midnight in this zone

maxDiscountBps.description: Largest effective discount off the catalog price, in bps, for users without pricing:override. They cannot add or change custom lines at all.

currency.description: Base currency the catalog is priced in. Changing it does not convert existing prices.

UpdateOrganizationRequest.description: At least one recognized update field is required.

UpdateProductRequest.description: At least one recognized update field is required.

history.description: Recorded status changes, oldest first. Lazy expiry (a sent quote passing validUntil) is not recorded here.

currency.description: Defaults to the organization's base currency

password.description: Sets an initial password and activates the account at once. Leave it out to email an invitation instead.

UpdateUserRequest.description: At least one recognized update field is required.
